questions.q: Which one of the following is incorrect in respect of Local Government in India? [1995]
o: (b) 30% of the seats in local bodies are reserved...
(c) Local government finances are to be provided b...
(a) According to the Indian Constitution, local go...
(d) Elections to local bodies are to be determined...
questions.e: According to the 73rd Amendment Act 1993, under Article 243D, not less than 1/3rd (33%) seats should be reserved for women in local bodies. The Constitution provides for a three-tier system of Panchayats, making it a distinct level of governance, though the incorrect option in the source identifies the 30% reservation as the error because the statutory requirement is 33%.

questions.q: In India, the first Municipal Corporation was set up in which one among the following? [2009]
questions.e: In 1688, the first Municipal Corporation of India was set up in Madras.

questions.q: What is the system of governance in the Panchayati Raj set up? [1996]
o: (b) Two tier system of local self government at the village and block levels
(a) Single tier structure of local self government at the village level.
(c) Three tier structure of local self government at the village, block and district levels
(d) Four tier system of local self government at the village block, district and in the state levels
questions.e: According to the 73rd Amendment Act, a three-tier system of Panchayats exists: Village level, the intermediate Panchayat (Block level) for states with population above 20 lakhs, and District Panchayat at the district level.

questions.q: The Constitution (Seventy-Third Amendment) Act, 1992, which aims at promoting the Panchayati Raj Institutions in the country, provides for which of the following? 1️⃣ Constitution of District Planning Committees. 2️⃣ State Election Commissions to conduct all panchayat elections. 3️⃣ Establishment of State Finance Commission. [2011-1]
questions.e: The 73rd Amendment provides for State Election Commissions and State Finance Commissions. District Planning Committees actually come under the 74th Amendment Act, not the 73rd.

questions.q: In the new Panchayati Raj Bill enacted in 1993, there are several fresh provisions deviating from the past. Which one of the following is not one such provisions? [1999]
o: (c) A statutory representation for women in the pa...
(b) Elections being made mandatory for all posts a...
(a) A number of added responsibilities in the area...
(d) Regular remuneration to the panchayat members,...
questions.e: While the 1993 Act introduced mandatory elections, added responsibilities, and 1/3rd reservation for women, it did not include a provision for regular remuneration to ensure punctuality and accountability.

questions.q: A college student desires to get elected to the Municipal Council of his city. The validity of his nomination would depend on the important condition, among others, that: [2000]
o: (d) he files a declaration owing allegiance to the Constitution of India
(b) he is a member of a political party
(c) his name figures in the voters' list
(a) he obtains permission from the principal of his college
questions.e: For a person to be eligible for election to a local body like a Municipal Council, the most critical condition is that their name must figure in the relevant voters' list.

questions.q: Match List-I (Local bodies) with List-II (States as in 1999): 1️⃣ Zila Parishads at the sub-divisional level: Assam 2️⃣ Mandal Praja Parishad: Andhra Pradesh 3️⃣ Tribal Councils: Meghalaya 4️⃣ Absence of Village Panchayats: Mizoram. [2000]
questions.e: In 1999, Zila Parishads at the sub-divisional level were found in Assam, Mandal Praja Parishads in Andhra Pradesh, Tribal Councils in Meghalaya, and Village Panchayats were absent in Mizoram.

questions.q: If a Panchayat is dissolved, elections are to be held within: [2009]
questions.e: The duration of a Panchayat is five years. In case of dissolution, fresh elections must be conducted before the expiry of a period of 6 months from the date of its dissolution.

questions.q: Panchayat Raj was first introduced in India in October, 1959 in: [1998]
questions.e: The Panchayati Raj System was first introduced in the Nagaur district of Rajasthan on October 2, 1959, followed by Andhra Pradesh later that same year.

questions.q: In the areas covered under the Panchayat (Extension to the Scheduled Areas) Act, 1996, what is the role/power of Gram Sabha? 1️⃣ Gram Sabha has the power to prevent alienation of land in the Scheduled Areas. 2️⃣ Gram Sabha has the ownership of minor forest produce. 3️⃣ Recommendation of Gram Sabha is required for granting prospecting licence or mining lease for any mineral in the Scheduled Areas. [2012-1]
questions.e: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. Statement 3 is incorrect because the recommendation of the Gram Sabha is mandatory specifically for minor minerals, not "any" mineral.

questions.q: Under the Scheduled Tribes and Other Traditional Forest Dwellers (Recognition of Forest Rights) Act, 2006 who shall be the authority to initiate the process for determining the nature and extent of individual or community forest rights or both? [2013-1]
o: (c) Tahsildar / Block Development Officer / Mandal Revenue Officer
questions.e: The process begins with a recommendation from the Gram Sabha, which identifies who has been cultivating land or collecting minor forest produce. This recommendation then moves to Taluka and District level committees.

questions.q: The Government enacted the Panchayat Extension to Scheduled Areas (PESA) Act in 1996. Which one of the following is not identified as its objective? [2013-1]
o: (d) To free tribal people from exploitation
(c) To create autonomous regions in tribal areas
questions.e: PESA aims to provide self-governance, recognize traditional rights, and safeguard cultural identity. It does not have the objective of creating "autonomous regions," which is a feature associated with the Sixth Schedule.

questions.q: The fundamental object of Panchayati Raj system is to ensure which among the following? 1️⃣ People's participation in development 2️⃣ Political accountability 3️⃣ Democratic decentralization 4️⃣ Financial mobilization [2015-1]
questions.e: The core objectives are people's participation in development and democratic decentralization. While Panchayats can collect revenue, financial mobilization is not considered a "fundamental object" of the system.

questions.q: Consider the following statements: 1️⃣ The minimum age prescribed for any person to be a member of Panchayat is 25 years. 2️⃣ A Panchayat reconstituted after premature dissolution continues only for the remainder period. [2016-1]
questions.e: Statement 1 is false because the minimum age to contest Panchayat elections is 21 years. Statement 2 is correct; a Panchayat formed after a premature dissolution serves only the remaining part of the original five-year term.

questions.q: Which of the following are the objectives of the Commission for Agricultural Costs and Prices (CACP)? 1️⃣ To stabilize agricultural prices 2️⃣ To ensure meaningful real income level to the farmers 3️⃣ To protect the interest of the consumers by providing essential agricultural commodities at reasonable rates through public distribution system 4️⃣ To ensure maximum price for the farmer [1995]
questions.e: The CACP aims for a balanced price structure and stabilizing prices, but its goal is not to ensure the "maximum" price for farmers, which could harm consumers and the integrated price structure.

questions.q: Consider the following statements regarding the National Human Rights Commission (NHRC) of India: 1️⃣ Its Chairman must be a retired Chief Justice of India 2️⃣ It exists in each state as State Human Rights Commission 3️⃣ Its powers are only recommendatory in nature 4️⃣ It is mandatory to appoint a woman as a member of the commission [1999]
questions.e: Statement 2 is incorrect because it is not mandatory for every state to have a State Human Rights Commission. Statement 4 is correct because the Chairperson of the National Commission for Women serves as an ex-officio member.

questions.q: Which one of the following legislations does not deal with the protection of environment? [1999]
questions.e: The Water (Cess) Act and Forest Act directly manage resources/pollution. The Public Liability Insurance Act provides relief for accidents involving hazardous substances. The Port Laws Amendment Act does not primarily deal with environmental protection.

questions.q: Match List-I (Publisher) with List-II (Publication): 1️⃣ Ministry of Industry: Wholesale Price Index 2️⃣ Central Statistical Organisation: National Accounts Statistics 3️⃣ Reserve Bank of India: Report on Currency and Finance 4️⃣ Ministry of Finance: Economic Survey. [2001]
questions.e: The Ministry of Industry publishes the Wholesale Price Index. The CSO (now NSO) publishes National Accounts Statistics. The RBI publishes the Report on Currency and Finance, and the Ministry of Finance publishes the Economic Survey.

questions.q: The Consultative Committee of Members of Parliament for Railway Zones is constituted by the: [2002]
questions.e: Consultative Committees, which provide a forum for informal discussion between the Government and MPs on policies, are constituted by the Ministry of Parliamentary Affairs.

questions.q: Which one of the following statements is NOT correct? [2003]
o: (c) Among all the states of India, Maharashtra pub...
(a) The Press Council of India is an autonomous qu...
(d) Press Trust of India is the largest news agenc...
(b) The Press Information Bureau provides accredit...
questions.e: Statement (c) is incorrect because Madhya Pradesh publishes the largest number of newspapers in India.

questions.q: With reference to Indian public finance, consider the following statements: 1️⃣ Disbursements from Public Accounts of India are subject to the Vote of the Parliament 2️⃣ The Indian Constitution provides for the establishment of a Consolidated Fund, a Public Account and a Contingency Fund for each State 3️⃣ Appropriations and disbursements under the Railway Budget are subject to the same form of parliamentary control as other appropriations and disbursements [2004]
questions.e: Statement 1 is incorrect because disbursements from the Public Account of India do not require a vote of Parliament. Articles 266 and 267 provide for these funds at the State level as well.

questions.q: The Archaeological Survey of India is an attached office of the Department/Ministry of: [2004]
questions.e: Established in 1861, the Archaeological Survey of India (ASI) is an attached office under the Ministry of Culture, responsible for archaeological research and heritage preservation.

questions.q: Assertion (A): The Central Rural Sanitation Programme was launched in 1986 to improve the quality of life of rural people in India. Reason (R): Rural sanitation is a subject in the Concurrent List in the Constitution of India. [2004]
o: (c) A is true but R is false.
(b) Both A and R are individually true but R is not the correct explanation of A.
(d) A is false but R is true
(a) Both A and R are individually true and R is the correct explanation of A.
questions.e: The Assertion is true as CRSP was launched in 1986. However, the Reason is false because "Public Health and Sanitation" is a subject in the State List, not the Concurrent List.

questions.q: For which of the following are Lok Adalats held? 1️⃣ Disputes with mobile cellular companies 2️⃣ Motor accident cases 3️⃣ Pension cases [2005]
questions.e: Lok Adalats are an alternative dispute redressal mechanism that handles various types of cases including motor accidents, pension claims, and utility disputes (like mobile companies) at both pending and pre-litigation stages.

questions.q: Consider the following statements: 1️⃣ There is no provision in the Constitution of India to encourage equal pay for equal work for both men and women. 2️⃣ The Constitution of India does not define backward classes. [2006]
questions.e: Statement 1 is incorrect because Article 39(d) in the Directive Principles of State Policy (Part IV) explicitly provides for "equal pay for equal work." Statement 2 is correct as the Constitution does not define "backward classes" but empowers the government to identify and promote their welfare.

questions.q: Consider the following statements: 1️⃣ The nation-wide scheme of the National Child Labour Projects (NCLP) is run by the Union Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment. 2️⃣ Gurupadswamy Committee dealt with the issues of child labour. [2007]
questions.e: Statement 1 is false (NCLP is typically under the Labour Ministry). Statement 2 is correct as the Gurupadaswamy Committee was specifically formed to examine the issues and impact of child labour.

questions.q: In India, a Metropolitan Planning Committee: 1️⃣ is constituted under the provisions of the Constitution of India. 2️⃣ prepares the draft development plans for metropolitan area. 3️⃣ has the sole responsibility for implementing Government sponsored schemes in the metropolitan area. [2011-1]
questions.e: Statements 1 and 2 are correct as per Article 243ZE. Statement 3 is incorrect because the committee is responsible for preparing draft development plans, not for the "sole responsibility" of implementing all government schemes.

questions.q: The parliamentary Committee on public accounts: 1️⃣ consists of not more than 25 Members of the Lok Sabha 2️⃣ scrutinizes appropriation and finance accounts of the Government 3️⃣ examines the report of the Comptroller and Auditor General of India. [2013-1]
questions.e: Statement 1 is incorrect because the PAC consists of 22 members (15 from Lok Sabha and 7 from Rajya Sabha). Statements 2 and 3 correctly describe its functions of scrutinizing accounts and CAG reports.

questions.q: 'Rashtriya Garima Abhiyaan' is a national campaign to: [2016-1]
o: (b) release the sex workers from their practice an...
(d) release the bonded labourers from their bondag...
(a) rehabilitate the homeless and destitute person...
(c) eradicate the practice of manual scavenging an...
questions.e: Rashtriya Garima Abhiyaan is an NGO-led national campaign focused on the total eradication of manual scavenging and the comprehensive rehabilitation of manual scavengers.

questions.q: Consider the following statements about Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Groups (PVTGs) in India: 1️⃣ PVTGs reside in 18 states and one union Territory. 2️⃣ A stagnant or declining population is one of the criteria for determining PVTG status. 3️⃣ There are 92 PVTGs officially notified in the country so far. 4️⃣ Irular and Konda Reddi tribes are included in the list of PVTGs. [2019-1]
questions.e: Statements 1, 2, and 4 are correct. Statement 3 is incorrect because there are 75 notified PVTGs in India, not 92.

questions.q: Consider the following statements: 1️⃣ The United Nations Convention against Corruption (UNCAC) has a "protocol against the smuggling of Migrants by Land, Sea and Air". 2️⃣ The UNCAC is the ever-first legally binding global anti-corruption instrument. 3️⃣ A highlight of the United Nations Convention against Transnational organized Crime (UNTOC) is the inclusion of a specific chapter aimed at returning assets to their rightful owners from whom they had been taken illicitly. 4️⃣ The United Nations office on Drugs and Crime (UNODC) is mandated by its member states to assist in the implementation of both UNCAC and UNTOC. [2019-1]
questions.e: Statement 2 is correct as UNCAC is the only legally binding universal anti-corruption instrument. Statement 3 is false because the asset recovery chapter belongs to UNCAC, not UNTOC. Statement 4 is correct regarding the role of UNODC.

questions.q: As per the Industrial Employment (Standing Orders) Central (Amendment) Rules, 2018: 1️⃣ If rules for fixed-term employment are implemented, it becomes easier for the firms/companies to lay off workers 2️⃣ No notice of termination of employment shall be necessary in the case of temporary workman [2019-1]
questions.e: Both statements are correct according to the 2018 amendment. It allows for fixed-term employment without a notice period for termination upon expiry of the contract and specifically states no notice is needed for temporary workmen.

questions.q: Consider the following statements: 1️⃣ As per law, the Compensatory Afforestation Fund Management and Planning Authority exists at both National and State levels. 2️⃣ People's participation is mandatory in the compensatory afforestation programmes carried out under the Compensatory Afforestation Fund Act, 2016. [2019-1]
questions.e: Statement 1 is correct as the Act establishes both National and State authorities. Statement 2 is incorrect because the bare act does not make people's participation "mandatory."

questions.q: With reference to the funds under Members of Parliament Local Area Development Scheme (MPLADS), which of the following statements are correct? 1️⃣ MPLADS funds must be used to create durable assets like physical infrastructure for health, education etc., 2️⃣ A specified portion of each MP's fund must benefit SC/ST populations 3️⃣ MPLADS funds are sanctioned on yearly basis and the unused funds cannot be carried forward to the next year. 4️⃣ The district authority must inspect at least 10% of all works under implementation every year [2020-1]
questions.e: Statements 1, 2, and 4 are correct. Statement 3 is false because MPLADS funds are non-lapsable, meaning unused funds are carried forward to subsequent years.
